listing.name: Voidling Hatchery
listing.summary: A small addon mod for https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1212105491983896616 utilizing bananaFactory to hatch Voidlings.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a hatchery interface to produce Voidlings using bananaFactory.

description: Adds a hatchery interface to produce Voidlings using bananaFactory. The feature allows players to select parent Voidlings and monitor the production progress of Voidling Eggs.
descriptionHtml: Adds a hatchery interface to produce Voidlings using bananaFactory. The feature allows players to select parent Voidlings and monitor the production progress of Voidling Eggs.
discordPostHtml:
A small addon mod for https://discord.com/channels/187635036525166592/1212105491983896616 utilizing bananaFactory to hatch Voidlings.
Download: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jVan8xBr8_GOOCv_oGEgEZ8gckEw2gNq/view
Dependency: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=31532.0
Make sure you download all dependencies for bananaFactory too
aiDescription: Adds a hatchery interface to produce Voidlings using bananaFactory. The feature allows players to select parent Voidlings and monitor the production progress of Voidling Eggs.

gallery.aiCaption: A circular green emblem featuring a DNA helix structure.
A game interface showing the date 'Jan 1, 206' with a red arrow pointing to a small icon labeled 'click'.
A menu titled 'Open production interface' with keyboard shortcuts and a red circle labeled '2'.
A ship selection screen showing '1x Voidling Egg' in the hatchery with handwritten instructions to 'choose parent Voidlings'.
The fleetwide industry and logistics interface showing a ship selection for producing a 'Voidling Egg' with red annotations.
A game screen with handwritten text instructing to ensure the symbol looks correct to commence production.
A progress bar for '1x Voidling Egg' at 50% with handwritten text 'Alt+click to pop out progressbar'.
An inventory grid showing a green egg icon with handwritten text stating the egg will appear in your inventory.
